mapper.select: SELECT id,compCode AS code FROM t_company LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_id AS id,user_name AS username FROM t_user LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.`projectId`,p.`projectType`,p.`projectCode`,p.`projectName`,p.`projectState`,p.`isback`,p.`column001`,p.`column002`,p.`column003`,p.`column004`,p.`column005`,p.`column006`,p.`column007`,p.`column008`,p.`column009`,p.`column010`,p.`column011`,p.`column012`,p.`columno12_readonly`,p.`column013`,p.`column014`,p.`customerProjectName`,p.`salesType`,p.`majorProjectLevel`,p.`compId`,p.`createTime`,p.`createBy`,p.`updateTime`,p.`updateBy`,p.`effectiveFrom`,p.`effectiveTo`,CAST(p.disabled AS UNSIGNED) AS disabled,p.`projectStartTime`,p.`projectRefreshTime`,p.`projectCloseTime`,p.`customInfo`,p.`customConfig` FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.projectId=p.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND p.projectType='10' ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.projectId,p.projectType,p.projectCode,chosen.projectId AS canonicalProjectId FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.typeKey=CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY) AND chosen.codeKey=CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY) JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=chosen.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.projectType='10' ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT #{limit}
